# Mast (auto-generated by `python -m rnd.run_all`)

Worst static moment at the mast foot: **48 N·m** (both arms straight forward with 1 kg each, torso at the top of 1.06 m). Target: torso sway ≤ 2.0 mm.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2040 extrusion (v0 placeholder) | 69,000 | 0.50 | 5.7 mm ⚠️ | 14 MPa |
| 40×40×2 Al square tube | 73,365 | 0.82 | 5.3 mm ⚠️ | 13 MPa |
| 50×50×2 Al square tube | 147,712 | 1.04 | 2.7 mm ⚠️ | 8 MPa |
| 60×60×2 Al square tube **← chosen** | 260,459 | 1.25 | 1.5 mm ✅ | 6 MPa |

The carriage runs on 8 × 625 bearings (two per face, top and bottom) on the tube's flat faces; the square section also stops the torso from turning.
The lift belt (HTD 5M, motor fixed at the mast foot, idler inside the head) and the printed ratchet strip run on the tube's back face.
